thread:
sam_cust: hitting errors on the /v1/generate endpoint since yesterday, lots of 5xx and a few auth failures. can't paste the raw prompt (contains customer emails/IDs). request_id: req-0a12b3f, started around 2026-03-15T22:10Z. can you help collect a safe sample and the logs?

maya_support: sorry about that — we can help. quick checklist: 1) we need the request_id, model, endpoint, and a redacted curl that reproduces the problem (no auth tokens or real PII). 2) a short timeline with approximate timestamps. 3) if you can run a client trace (curl --trace-ascii) that helps. don't upload raw PII to the channel.

sam_cust: thanks. i can give a sanitized curl and timeline. curious what's the best way to share the sanitized bundle securely?

maya_support: two options we use: 1) post the sanitized curl inline here (small snippet) 2) upload a single encrypted archive to our secure intake and paste the presigned link. if you upload, set expiry to 24h and mark the file as "masked". alex_devex can post the intake link.

alex_devex: i can create a short-lived upload. prefer tar.gz with a README that lists what you masked and the mapping method (hash vs placeholder). we'll accept: request.log (truncated headers), response.log (status + body length + error message), and a sample masked-payload.json with the exact curl payload but with identifiers replaced by consistent tokens.

sam_cust: example of the masked curl i'm planning to paste:

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-2","input":"Hello, my name is CUSTOMER_123. please show last order status for ORDER_999.","request_id":"req-0a12b3f"}'
```

sam_cust: and i'll swap real emails for CUSTOMER_123 and order ids for ORDER_999. ok?

maya_support: perfect — please also include the exact status codes and latency you observed (from your client). if you have a server-side trace_id header (X-Trace-Id), include it but remove any JWT/authorization header values.

leo_security: quick note from security: do not include complete credit card numbers, SSNs, or full customer addresses in the upload. if any of those exist, pseudonymize (e.g., CC_XXXX_4242, SSN_XXX_6789). also state whether the data is covered by any regulatory regime.

sam_cust: understood. one more: how should i capture headers? strip Authorization and Cookies, but keep X-Request-Id and User-Agent?

maya_support: yes. keep X-Request-Id, X-Trace-Id, Content-Length, and the endpoint path. redact Authorization/Cookies. if you can, replace actual hostnames with example.com (for internal endpoints).

sam_cust: ok uploading masked bundle now.

upload-bot: presigned link created: https://uploads.redwood-secure/s/exp/abc123 (expires in 24h)

maya_support: got it, thanks. i'll pull the bundle and run through repro steps. if we need raw logs we'll request them and coordinate a secure transfer with you.

alex_devex: next steps from our side: 1) repro attempt with masked payload 2) if reproduction succeeds, we'll request a minimum necessary raw log excerpt (time-windowed) via secure intake 3) if you approve, we can do a short live debug session with net logs masked.

sam_cust: sounds good. appreciate the guidance — i'll add a README inside the bundle that lists what was replaced and the original request timestamps.

leo_security: once the case is closed, please confirm deletion of the presigned object or request a retention extension. we won't store raw customer PII in support threads. :lock: 

maya_support: noted — case ENG-3241. i'll update here after the first repro run. thanks!
